title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go and bump parity to v1.38.0
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: SDK users saw subtle parity mismatches between Python/TypeScript/Go around auth token refresh, retry semantics for transient 5xx and 429 responses, and streaming API ergonomics (cancellation and incremental errors). This PR unifies the surface area and default behavior across all three SDKs so library users can rely on consistent semantics and reduce cross-language diffs. Changes include: 1) standardized auth layer that surfaces token-refresh hooks and a single config for credential propagation; 2) unified retry policy: default exponential backoff with jitter, retryable status set (429, 502, 503, 504), idempotency hints for non-idempotent endpoints; 3) streaming ergonomics: consistent event types for data/error/complete and a cancellable client-side iterator/async generator pattern in each language; 4) small ergonomics improvements: clearer error types, typed response wrappers, and consolidated docs/examples. Checklist: - [x] Implement core abstractions in each SDK - [x] Add integration tests exercising token refresh under concurrent requests - [x] Add streaming cancellation tests and error propagation tests - [x] Update SDK docs and quickstart examples - [x] Bump package versions to v1.38.0 and update changelogs Notes: There are no breaking API changes for common usage patterns, but some internal helper types were consolidated which may require minor import adjustments for advanced users. See release notes for migration hints.

Standardized auth middleware with token-refresh hooks
Unified retry policy with exponential backoff, jitter, and common retryable statuses
Streaming API ergonomics: cancellable iterators/async generators and consistent event model
